description: This file defines the 'Node' class, which manages hierarchical configuration data with properties of various types, supporting serialization and property retrieval.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a configuration node with hierarchical properties, supporting type conversions and serialization.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Default constructor, needed for XML encoding.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Protected constructor initializing node with a prefix and parent map, reusing existing nodes if present.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Static method to check if a string can be parsed as a number.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns a child node with the specified name, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getIntProperty
methods.description: Retrieves an integer property by key, returning a default if parsing fails.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property by key, with an overload for default value.

methods.name: setProperty

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property with a boolean value.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property with a default fallback.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property, defaulting to empty string if not set.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the node (used by serializer).

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix of the node (used by serializer).

methods.name: toString

methods.name: getDoubleProperty
